author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Run

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friends. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host picks the mode, level and speed with the mouse; everyone starts together and runs at their own pace.

keys.key: Left and Right or A and D

keys.does: Jump, or go to the next level.

tips: Each player has their own runner, level and screen: it's a race, and you don't see the others.
Only the host's mouse works in the menus; friends start from the host's unlocked levels.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
New: not yet played by people on two PCs or over the internet. Tell us how it runs.

description: Run (player_03, 2008): race through the tunnel levels with up to 3 friends. Everyone runs their own copy of the game on their own PC, on the mode and level the host picks.
